**Finding: COMPLIANT (no redline)**

The renewal mechanics sit in Section 13 (p0078), not in sec-2 or sec-5 as the planner hinted:

- **Renewal term:** successive **one-year** periods — matches the preferred 12-month renewal; no multi-year auto-renewal.
- **Non-renewal notice window:** **30 days**, exercisable by either party, so we can exit unilaterally — at the preferred ≤30 days, comfortably inside the ≤60-day fallback and far from the >90-day walk-away trigger.
- **Pricing:** p0047 freezes Hosting Services costs for the first year and adds an MFN rate commitment (a protection running in our favour). There is no express renewal uplift cap and no Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal — both preferred sub-elements, treated per playbook convention as rationale notes rather than deviations.

The clause meets the preferred position on its material terms, so no redline was proposed.
